_comment: The briefs every arm of the experiment is run on. Kept in the repo because a comparison whose inputs live only in shell history is not a result anyone can check, including me later.

briefs.bakery: A sourdough bakery in Bristol called Tide Mill. Two ovens, no cafe, sells out by noon. Wants people to know the collection times and the weekly loaf.
briefs.clinic: A physiotherapy clinic in Leeds called Kestrel. Sports injuries and post-op rehab, two practitioners, no gym contract required.
briefs.devtool: An open-source CLI called Flint that finds unused database indexes in Postgres. Read-only, runs in CI, MIT licensed.
